description: This file defines an abstract actor class 'DittoRootActor' for the Eclipse Ditto service, implementing supervision strategies, actor management, and HTTP route binding using Akka framework.

classes.name: DittoRootActor
classes.description: An abstract Akka actor class managing supervision, child actors, and HTTP status routes for a Ditto service.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling for starting child actors, logging failures, and handling unknown messages.

methods.name: supervisorStrategy
methods.description: Returns the supervision strategy configured for this actor.

methods.name: getSupervisionDecider
methods.description: Provides the partial function that determines supervision directives based on thrown exceptions.

methods.name: startChildActor
methods.description: Starts a new child actor with a given name and Props.

methods.name: restartChild
methods.description: Returns a directive to restart a child actor.

methods.name: bindHttpStatusRoute
methods.description: Sets up an HTTP server binding for status routes, with hostname and port configuration.
